name: 2 Minutes for Roughing
source:
Paige loves hockey. She's studied and played on and off the ice for as long as she can remember. Her knowledge and toughness are top notch. While she's never been gifted in natural skill, she's one of the best when it comes to adapting to opponents and teammates. There's only one problem, her temper. Paige has racked up in numerous suspensions and even been kicked off teams for her legendary bouts of rage.

However, she finally feels like she has her temper under wraps and she's ready to give her favorite sport another go. Her brother has agreed to bring her to practice with his dek hockey team to see if she's ready to handle competition once again. First step, making sure she can get along with her new teammates!
translation:
佩奇熱愛冰上曲棍球。從她記事起，她就一直在冰場上或冰場下學習、練習這項運動。她的知識和堅韌都無可挑剔。雖然她沒有天生的運動才能，但說到適應對手和隊友，她絕對是最優秀的人之一。唯一的問題是她的脾氣。佩奇因為傳說般的暴怒而累計了大量禁賽處罰，甚至還被球隊除名過。

不過，她終於覺得自己控制住了脾氣，準備再次嘗試最喜歡的運動。她的哥哥答應帶她去參加自己的地板曲棍球球隊訓練，看看她是否已經準備好再次面對競爭。第一步，是確認她能和新隊友們相處融洽！
